column1: # Metals from the world (11-05, Ronald: "Worn armour art, metals"): copper and tin ore marks drawn alone on magenta, laid over stone's own graded tile by grade.toml (base = "stone"), as gold's are; the crucible's and forge's faces. BLOCK_LIKE=gold_ore,iron_ore,furnace_front,stone

column3: ore_copper@-|cutout|Copper ore marks only, BOLD: 5 or 6 chunky clusters 4-7 px across scattered over the square, each a lump of bright green malachite (#1f5a3a #2e8a52 #4cb874 #8ee0a8) with a few small nuggets of shiny native copper (#5a2a12 #9c4a1e #d8763a #f6b07a) in it, a dark green-brown outline (#1a3020), lit from the top left, together covering about 35% of the square, not touching the edges; everything else flat solid magenta. Must read clearly as green copper ore against grey-green stone from far away
column4: ore_tin@-|cutout|Tin ore marks only: 4 or 5 small clusters of cassiterite crystals 3-6 px across, very dark brown-black heavy grains (#1c1410 #33261c #4e3a2a #7a6450) with a few bright silvery-white glints on their upper left facets (#d8dce0), a pale tan ring round each cluster where the rock is weathered (#b8a888), lit from the top left, together covering about 25% of the square, not touching the edges; everything else flat solid magenta. Reads as rare dark tin stone, quite different from coal (no black seam) and from iron (no rust)

column3: crucible_top|face|Crucible top, seen from above: a round fired-clay crucible (#6a3a22 #9a5a34 #c07a4a #d89a68) set in a square hearth of red bricks (#453526 #7a5239 #ac684c #c17d52), glowing molten bronze in the crucible's mouth (#7a2a08 #d86a10 #f6b030 #ffe28a), glowing charcoal round it (#3a1a10 #b8401a #f08a2a), 16 px across the crucible
column4: crucible_side|face|Crucible side: a squat hearth of red bricks (#453526 #7a5239 #ac684c #c17d52 #d6b798) with a low arched opening at the bottom showing glowing charcoal (#3a1a10 #b8401a #f08a2a #ffd070), a round fired-clay crucible (#6a3a22 #9a5a34 #c07a4a) rising above the brick rim, lit from the top left
column5: forge_top|face|Forge top: a square hearth of dark iron-bound brick (#303635 #453526 #7a5239 #ac684c) with a bed of glowing coals in the middle (#2a1410 #8a2a10 #e05a14 #ffb040 #ffe8a0), an iron tuyere pipe entering from one side (#4a4e50 #7a8288 #b0b8bc), soot-dark edges
column6: forge_side|face|Forge side: a sturdy brick forge (#453526 #7a5239 #ac684c #c17d52) bound with dark iron straps and rivets (#2a2e30 #5a6066 #9aa2a8), a leather bellows on the left side (#4a2a1a #7a4a2a #a87048), an opening in the middle glowing orange (#8a2a10 #e05a14 #ffb040 #ffe8a0), a stone top edge, lit from the top left
